scripts.build:runtime: cd ../.. && cargo +nightly --config web/.cargo/config.toml build -p webrogue-web-runtime --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir web/frontend/generated/runtime --out-name webrogue_web_runtime target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/webrogue_web_runtime.wasm
scripts.build:runtime-dist: npm run build:runtime && rm -rf runtime_dist && esbuild src/runtime-worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --platform=browser --external:node:fs/promises --outfile=runtime_dist/runtime-worker.js && cp generated/runtime/webrogue_web_runtime.js generated/runtime/webrogue_web_runtime.d.ts generated/runtime/webrogue_web_runtime_bg.wasm node_modules/@bytecodealliance/jco-transpile/vendor/*.wasm runtime_dist/
scripts.check:imports: npm run check:imports:runtime && npm run check:imports:generate && npm run check:imports:typecheck
scripts.check:imports:runtime: cd ../.. && cargo +nightly --config web/.cargo/config.toml build -p webrogue-web-runtime --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir web/frontend/generated/runtime-check --out-name webrogue_web_runtime target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/webrogue_web_runtime.wasm
scripts.check:imports:generate: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('generated/example-imports', { recursive: true, force: true })" && jco transpile ../../webrogue-sdk/examples/sdl_woodeneye/build/woodeneye -o generated/example-imports --name main --instantiation async --async-mode jspi --no-component-error-wrapping --no-nodejs-compat --base64-cutoff 5000 --bindgen-enable-wasm-exnref
